subject.title: feat(zed): control Crabbox from Zed via CLI tasks

question: Should Crabbox own and maintain this Zed extension as a first-party package under `integrations/zed`?
rationale: The patch adds a new user-facing integration and recurring editor-platform maintenance commitment, and no maintainer discussion currently confirms that product boundary.

options.title: Sponsor the in-repo integration
options.body: Accept the first-party Zed surface after the snippet fix and convincing live behavior proof are added.

options.title: Publish it separately
options.body: Move the extension to a standalone Zed package repository and keep only a concise integration link or task example in Crabbox documentation.

options.title: Limit scope to documentation
options.body: Decline a maintained extension package and document user-owned `.zed/tasks.json` examples instead.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the in-repo integration
recommendation.body: Accept the first-party Zed surface after the snippet fix and convincing live behavior proof are added.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice determines the repository's long-term editor-integration ownership boundary.
